options: A particle with the same mass but opposite charge
questions.explanation: Antiparticles have the same mass as their corresponding matter particles, but have opposite electrical charges and quantum numbers.

questions.q: What happens when a particle and its antiparticle interact?
options: They merge into a heavier particle
They annihilate each other, releasing energy
questions.explanation: Matter and antimatter annihilate upon contact, converting their mass entirely into energy.
